title: 재외공관 무관주재령 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:5:2:00006:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 5-2 (Education and Training of Stationed Military Attaches)
(1) Where the Minister of National Defense selects stationed military attaches pursuant to Article 5 (1) and (2), the Minister shall provide group training before dispatch to the receiving State to cultivate the basic qualifications and capabilities necessary to perform their missions.
(2) In order to improve the capabilities of stationed military attaches in performing their missions, the Minister of National Defense may periodically assemble them for job-related training in Korea or abroad during their assignments.
